title: Say hello
openingContent: Start with three greetings you can use in everyday Spanish. A simple **hola** is enough to start a conversation at any time of day.

title: Introduce yourself
openingContent: Use **me llamo** followed by your name to introduce yourself. You can say **mucho gusto** when you meet someone.

title: Order a coffee
openingContent: Use **quisiera** to ask for something politely. Add **por favor** at the end of your order.
